policy.future_effective_items: BLOCK as current law/policy until the effective date, but treat as a pre-launch blocker if the intended launch crosses that date.
policy.draft_or_consultation_items: Never auto-promote a draft to current law. Recheck the official source at or before the watch date and require a new final instrument/effective date before changing status.
policy.refresh: Any item whose trigger/watch date is reached must fail the temporal QA until official-source status is refreshed.

items.note: Effective 2026-09-30: Google Play requires Play apps to be registered in Play Console; remaining unregistered apps must be registered to avoid global Play removal. Tailmance real Play Console registration remains external evidence and release-blocking.

Effective 2026-09-30: developer-verification installation protections are live for certified Android devices in Brazil, Indonesia, Singapore and Thailand across participating stores. Tailmance real developer identity/app registration state remains external evidence and release-blocking.

The 2026-09-18 instrument is an explicit consultation draft. The comment deadline is 2026-10-17; reaching that date does not make the draft law, but it requires a fresh official-source check. Re-checked 2026-10-25: the CAC page and state media still present it as a consultation draft and no final State Council text has been published, so it stays non-current. Next re-check 2026-11-25.
OAIC states the final Code must be finalised and registered by 2026-12-10. The exposure draft is not treated as the final current Code before registration.
Google Play's updated Location Permissions policy becomes effective 2027-01-27. Tailmance source currently blocks fine-location permission, but this remains a future conditional store-policy watch.

California Digital Age Assurance Act is effective in 2026 but expressly operative 2027-01-01; AB 1856 amended the framework in September 2026. Recheck final codified text/API implementation before launch.
Alabama HB161 enrolled text states 2027-01-01. Keep future-only and recheck official act/code status plus implementing rules before launch.
Utah developer obligations under current 13-76-202 begin 2027-05-06 after 2026 amendments.
Louisiana Act 185 prevents 2025 Act 481 from becoming effective and places the replacement substantive regime on a 2027-07-01 effective date.

EU KIDS Act was proposed 2026-09-17 and is not current law. Trigger date is an internal status-recheck deadline, not a statutory effective date. Re-verified 2026-10-25 on the Commission page: adopted by the Commission 2026-09-17 as a proposal; no Parliament/Council adoption or application date stated. Still not current law.

Bill C-34 remained proposed legislation as of 2026-09-29. Trigger date is an internal legislative-status recheck deadline. Re-verified 2026-10-25 on canada.ca: introduced 2026-06-10; page (last modified 2026-09-08) links the first-reading text and states no royal assent or in-force date. Still proposed legislation.

Government announced future under-16 social-media rules. Current OSA duties remain separate; trigger date is an internal status recheck. Re-verified 2026-10-25 on gov.uk: fact sheet (last visible update 2026-09-18) still uses future tense; no bill, Act or commencement date. Still announced policy.

Austria AVMS amendment is a consultation draft with planned 2027 commencement, not current law. Trigger date is an internal status recheck. Re-verified 2026-10-25 on oesterreich.gv.at: consultation ran 2026-07-27 to 2026-09-21; in-force date mostly 2027-01-01 expected but unconfirmed; applies to video-sharing platforms with certain features, not a blanket ban. Still a draft.
Spain announced an intended under-16 social-network restriction/age-verification measure; announcement is not enacted law. Trigger date is an internal status recheck.

Dutch position advocates an EU-wide minimum age; it is policy/proposal evidence, not a current Dutch standalone age ban. Trigger date is an internal status recheck. Re-verified 2026-10-25 on government.nl: position paper sent to the Commission jointly with Spain; no binding Dutch national age rule or date. Still proposal evidence.
Polish minors/pornography age-verification bill remained in legislative process in September 2026; trigger date is an internal legislative-status recheck.

MDDI stated on 2026-09-08 that necessary legislative amendments are planned by early 2027. Trigger date is an internal status recheck, not an effective date. Re-verified 2026-10-25 on mddi.gov.sg: amendments still planned, not introduced; timing 'early next year' (2027).

Décret n° 2026-883 was published 2026-09-24 and entered into force 2026-09-25. It is current, not future law. The trigger is an internal follow-up to confirm consolidated Code de la consommation implementation/enforcement details. Re-verified 2026-10-25 via Le Monde du Droit (secondary; Légifrance page not fetchable): published in the JO 2026-09-24, in force the day after (2026-09-25); strengthens accessibility provisions in the Code de la consommation. Still current.

Poland Dz.U. 2026 poz. 1005 amends the Animal Protection Act and enters into force 2027-07-28. It is enacted but not current as of 2026-09-29; recheck final consolidated companion-animal obligations before launch crossing the date.

Poland Dz.U. 2026 poz. 755 establishes the National Register of Marked Dogs and Cats with staged commencement and main entry into force 2028-06-11. Recheck whether Tailmance ownership/animal-profile flows create any operational dependency before the applicable milestone.

Portaria Conjunta SENACON/SEDIGI/SPDIGI nº 3/2026 was published 2026-09-23. Most paid-advertising/boosting duties become effective 30 days after publication. Tailmance contextual sponsored place/event promotion must remain fail-closed in Brazil until this effective date and the required retention/transparency controls are active. Effective date reached 2026-10-23 (re-confirmed 2026-10-25 against the published text); the controls are not yet verified, so Brazil paid promotion stays fail-closed.

Article 3 material-relationship disclosure tooling in Portaria Conjunta SENACON/SEDIGI/SPDIGI nº 3/2026 becomes effective 90 days after 2026-09-23 publication. Do not promote it to a current duty before 2026-12-22; source architecture should be ready before activation.
